scope: Frozen generated designs (including historical/failed/orphan versions) and isolated before-change baseline PNGs; not post-implementation screenshots

verification.method: Restored every regular PNG into a fresh owned temporary directory, checked exact bytes and SHA256, then cleaned that restoration only

gitPolicy: Text prompts/contracts/reviews/indexes are versioned. These large PNG originals remain locally at their referenced paths and in the verified independent archive; no existing tracked project image is removed.
